global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender noodles, topped with halved soft-boiled eggs and shredded menma. Served in a black bowl, it rests on a light wooden surface under bright, even lighting.

regions.background: Light wood-grain table surface with subtle vertical lines and natural texture visible around the bowl's edge.
regions.bowl: Black ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is rich, creamy brown, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its glossy, textured surface.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, curved surface and slightly tapered end.
regions.chopsticks: Chopsticks are light beige, smooth, cylindrical, with slightly tapered ends and faint wood grain texture.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk, creamy white, and glossy surface with a slightly runny center.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, glossy, and slightly curled with visible fibrous texture and sauce coating.
